description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for HDMI CEC plugin in WPEFramework, including frame listener, message processor, and plugin class with methods for enabling/disabling and settings management.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Implements FrameListener to handle HDMI CEC frames and notify MessageProcessor.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI CEC messages and manages connection.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class for HDMI CEC, providing interface for enabling/disabling, settings, and event handling.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set plugin enabled state via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get plugin enabled state via JSON parameters.

methods.name: setOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set OTP feature enabled state.

methods.name: getOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get OTP feature enabled state.
